violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: meat slicer in the prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CDI: MEAT SLICER WAS CLEANED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Chemicals for Washing Fruits & Vegetables
violations.observation: Chemicals that are being used to wash or peel raw, whole fruits and vegetables do not meet the requirements of 21 CFR 173.315. OBSERVED THE VEGGIE WASH AT 11.75 MILLILITERS WHEN TESTED.
violations.corrective_action: Chemicals used to wash or peel, raw whole fruits and vegetables must be approved as food additives or recognized as safe. CDI: PIC ADDED WATER DILUTE THE CONCENTRATION. CALL TECHNICIAN TO RE-ADJUST THE VEGGIE WASH DISPENSER.

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED WIPING CLOTH BUCKETS STORED NEXT TO EQUIPMENT THROUGHOUT THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: WIPING CLOTH BUCKETS WERE RE-LOCATED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There is no hand soap available at the front counter hand sink next to the ice cream freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The batteries in the unit need to be replaced. The PIC replaced the batteries during the inspection and placed a second bottle of handsoap at the sink during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: The paper towel dispenser at the hand sink next to the three compartment sink was not working due to the batteries being dead, thus there were no paper towels available at this site.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC provided an extra roll of paper towels for the top of the dispenser. CDI.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw tuna was found stored over lettuce and other produce in one of the kitchen refrigerators.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC moved the tuna to another unit to correct this. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: smoked salmon was 45º in one of the refrigerators. Oaxaca salsa was 52º, pineapple salsa was 52º and relish was 52º in one front counter 4-drawers prep top refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC moved the smoked salmon to the walk-in to cool it down. The PIC discarded the other products. CDI.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: a pair of tongs was stored in a wiping cloth sanitizer bucket; the handle for a food scoop was stored in the Cole slaw it was being used for; a small food scoop was stored in soiled standing water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The PIC corrected all of these issues during the inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Multi-Use Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth/Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surface of the following equipment contains cracks, chips, or pits and can not be easily cleaned: the spatula at one of the prep refrigerators on the cook line was melted, cracked and deteriorated.
violations.corrective_action: Multiuse food-contact surfaces shall be: 1) smooth, 2) free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, inclusions, pits, and similar imperfections, 3) free of sharp integral angles, corners, and crevices, 4) finished to have smooth welds and joints, and 5) accessible for cleaning and inspection. Cleaning and inspection shall be completed by one of the following methods: (a) without being disassembled, (b). by disassembling without the use of tools, or (c) by easy disassembling with the use of handheld tools. The PIC discarded the spatula during the inspection.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Some of the refrigerator door handles had food debris buildup on them.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please clean the refrigerator door handles as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed there was a light shield missing from one of the light fixtures over the hot holding unit in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Please replace the missing light shield as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. The food employee on the cook line cracked raw shell eggs with gloved hands, then proceeded to handle raw ground beef and cooking utensils without changing gloves or washing hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. The EHS discussed this with the manager and the manager discussed it with the employee. The employee washed their hands and changed gloves.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut tomatoes, cut lettuce, sliced pepperjack cheese, and blue cheese were out of temperature in the burger station 2-drawer (unit #2), with temperatures or 47ºF, 46ºF, 46ºF, and 46ºF, respectively.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The person in charge (PIC) discarded the items and will have the unit serviced or adjusted.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: the pecan pie and heavy cream were out of proper cold holding temperature in unit #11 with temperatures or 51ºF, and 50ºF, respectively.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC moved all items in the unit to another unit and will have the unit serviced.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: knives, spatulas and other in-use cooking utensils at the large griddle station were being stored in standing water that was 93ºF.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The PIC spoke with the food employee about this and corrected it by moving the container to the hotter grill. Ensure the water is 135ºF before placing utensils in it. Also, ensure the water is changed when food debris is present in the water.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the ambient temperature of the dessert refrigerator (unit #11) was 44ºF, and the ambient temperature of the burger station unit (unit #2) was 44ºF, both with foods out of cold holding temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Please have these units adjusted or serviced as needed so they are capable of maintaining foods at 41ºF or below. Follow-up required for the is core violation. Please contact your EHS when corrected.

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board along the left side of the cook line is heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Please resurface or replace the cutting board with six months.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. There was an unapproved splitter on the mopsink, which doesn’t provide backflow prevention at the sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The EHS spoke with the PIC about this and provided an example of a suitable replacement device. Please remove the unapproved splitter or order and install a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve unit within 3 days and provide the EHS with proof of install. An image of the unit is also available in PLUS in the establishment record.
